Create a view, return an element, and let the platform open a window.

{{ <playground example="first-window" title="Open a window" /> }}

<a id="render"></a>
## Describe the view

A view is an ordinary Rust value that implements `Render`. GPUI calls `render`
when it needs the view's element tree. The returned `Div` fills its parent,
centers a string, and supplies the colors that the text inherits.

You do not create a native widget for each element. GPUI lays out this tree
and paints it into the window. See [the rendering contract](@/reference/rendering.md)
for the three phases involved.

Uses [gpui::Render](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/trait.Render.html), [gpui::div](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/fn.div.html), [gpui::Styled](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/trait.Styled.html).

```rust
use gpui::{AppContext, Context, IntoElement, Render, Window, div, prelude::*, rgb};

struct Greeting;

impl Render for Greeting {
    fn render(&mut self, _window: &mut Window, _cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> impl IntoElement {
        div()
            .size_full()
            .flex()
            .items_center()
            .justify_center()
            .bg(rgb(0xf7f6f2))
            .text_color(rgb(0x155b50))
            .text_2xl()
            .child("Hello, GPUI")
    }
}
```

[View this step in the source](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/site/examples/src/bin/first-window.rs#L4-L31).

<a id="window"></a>
## Give the view a window

`cx.new` gives GPUI ownership of the greeting and returns an `Entity<Greeting>`.
The window keeps that entity as its root view. Nothing in the greeting needs
to manage a graphics device or event loop.

`support::run` selects the platform, opens the window, and keeps the browser
application alive. The complete source below includes that helper. In a native
application, the entry point begins with `gpui_platform::application().run(...)`.

Uses [gpui::AppContext](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/trait.AppContext.html), [gpui::App::open_window](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/struct.App.html#method.open_window), [gpui::Application::run](https://docs.rs/gpui-ce/0.2.2/gpui/struct.Application.html#method.run).

```rust
pub fn main() {
    support::run(|_window, cx| cx.new(|_cx| Greeting));
}
```

[View this step in the source](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/site/examples/src/bin/first-window.rs#L33-L46).
